properties.name: MN-135 just south of Tower
properties.why: The last unfinished stretch of the Mesabi Trail — the trail still ends here; hikers walk MN-135.

properties.name: MN-135, Wahlsten area
properties.why: The long, straight no-shoulder stretch hikers faced for ~15 mi before the trail was built — the "before" view.

properties.name: MN-135 at Embarrass
properties.why: South end of the old Embarrass–Tower gap, where the trail dead-ended ~6 mi short of Tower.

properties.name: MN-169, Eagles Nest area
properties.why: The contrast shot: rebuilt 2018 with 8-ft shoulders — what a rebuilt highway looks like.

properties.name: MN-169 / E. Sheridan St, Ely
properties.why: East end of the Mesabi Trail, where the NCT continues east on Fernberg Rd toward Kawishiwi Falls.

properties.name: US-75 at Kent
properties.why: Two-lane US highway, 55 mph statutory default, narrow-to-no shoulder — the most exposed highway stretch on the western route.

properties.name: CR-88 southeast of Rothsay
properties.why: Northwest end of the 15.8-mi CR-88 stretch; paved county road, farm traffic.

properties.name: CR-88 at Fergus Falls
properties.why: Where the CR-88 road walk reaches town.

properties.name: US-59, Fergus Falls
properties.why: The route crosses I-94, US-59 and the Pelican River in close succession — the highest-traffic crossing on the corridor.

properties.name: MN-210 E, Fergus Falls
properties.why: Trunk highway through east Fergus Falls; the Central Lakes Trail trailhead sits on Hwy 210.

properties.name: ND-4 / Fort Abercrombie
properties.why: The Red River crossing: road-walk Minnesota meets off-road trail in North Dakota.
